name: Sunset Rings
description: Rings stack concentrically in a mixed ink palette, alternating direction row by row, like a target seen through haze.

code.style: --rule: ( overflow: hidden; position: relative; visibility: hidden; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { visibility: visible; } --pos: @pn(100% 50%, 0 50%); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; @size: 900% 1022%; background: @m(50, ( radial-gradient( ellipse 100% 40%, @pn(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)) 50%, transparent 0% ) @var(--pos) / calc(@n() * 2%) calc(@n() * 2%) no-repeat )); } @row(even) { :after { background: @m(50, ( radial-gradient( ellipse 100% 40%, @pn(var(--color4), var(--color3), var(--color2), var(--color1)) 50%, transparent 0 ) @var(--pos) / calc(@n() * 2%) calc(@n() * 2%) no-repeat )); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
